translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Ach in Diosal, oc'oc val a c'ool d'ayin
Aton sb'it vin̈aj David ix sb'itej ayic ix tumaj vin̈ yuj vin̈aj Natán schecab' Dios, yujto ix yic' ix Betsabé vin̈ yetb'eyumoc.

content.text: Ach in Diosal yujto tzin a xajanej, oc'oc val a c'ool d'ayin. A yuj a nivan oq'uelc'olal, sucsat in mul.
B'ic in el d'a masanil in mul, tzin a sacb'itani.
Yel toni ix och in mul, ix in ec' d'a yib'an̈, max b'atlaj satc'olal junoc rato in mul chi' vuuj.
Ix och val in mul chi' d'ayach. Ix in c'ulej chucal d'a yol a sat. Yuj chi' smoj val ac'an in yaelal. Max yal-laj yalchaj chucal d'ayach ayic tzin a ch'olb'itani.
Val yel, yictax valjub'al chuc in. Toxonton chuc in atax yic cuchb'il into och yuj ix in nun.
Val yel tza xajanej mach sgana tojolal d'a smasanil sc'ool. Yuj chi' ac' a jelanil d'ayin.
N̈iccanel in mul yic tzin sacb'icaneli. B'ic in eli, yic vach' sacxon̈ej tzin ajcan icha q'uen sacb'acom.
Ac'xi in tzalajc'olal in c'ana' yic tz'el in cusc'olal yuj b'aj ix ac' in yaelal sic'lab'il.
Man̈xo a nacot in mul chi', tza sucan sat masanil in chucal.
Ach in Diosal, tojolb'itej in pensar. A junoc ac' b'eyb'al tzac' d'ayin yic tzin c'anab'ajej yed' smasanil in c'ool.
Man̈ in ic'canel d'a ichan̈, man̈ ic'paxel a Santo Espíritu d'ayin.
Ac'xi in tzalajc'olal yuj in colnab'il. Ac' vip yic b'ecan in c'ool ach in c'anab'ajani,
yic vach' tzin c'ayb'ej eb' chuc yic sb'eyb'alej a b'eyb'al eb' yic smeltzajoch eb' d'a yol a c'ab'.
Ach in Diosal, ix ac' in colnab'il, man̈xo a cha in mil anima, colinel d'a in mul yic ol valan a tojolal d'a b'italil.
Mamin, jac in ti' yic ol ach in b'itani.
Tato a ofrenda, ma silab' n̈usb'il tza nib'ej, tzam vac'laj, ocxo jun, max a nib'ej paxlaj.
A tas a gana, aton eb' scus sc'ol yuj smul. Ach in Diosal, max a patiquejel-laj anima syiq'uem sb'a yujto sna sb'a yuj smul.
Ac' a vach'c'olal d'a Sion. Yuj svach'il a c'ool, b'oxiq'ue smuroal Jerusalén.
Ichato val chi' d'a tzalajc'olal ol aj a chaan silab' a gana tz'ac'ji d'ayach, aton noc' noc' sn̈usji. Ichato chi' ol ac'joc noc' vacax silab'il d'ayach d'a altar.
